items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: Let's see, what did I do on the Bill Cosby special?

ctx.x: Let's see, what did I do on the Bill Cosby special? Oh, yes. That goes back awhile. That was a group of singers. This was vocal writing. And I forget the name of the group now. They were on capital records and they did some work on the Cosby show, you know. I tell you what was so ironic about that. Cosby wanted one particular thing. Cosby wanted the Negro national anthem, "Lift Every Voice and Sing," you know?
